# Optimisation `m8_helio_optical`

Single heliocentric optical satellite + laser-PV receiver (example site): orbit, collector, transmitter, receiver, thermal and operations variables; maximise time-averaged grid power and availability above 1 kW, minimise the mass proxy; clear-sky screening (L0, 3896 s, batched Airy), high-fidelity re-evaluation (L1, 974 s, per-epoch reference capture, ERA5 cloud outages).

Search fidelity: `screening` — L0 two-body Kepler orbit (planets and SRP omitted; M7b measured 0.02 % on P_grid of the 1 au case), the day-incommensurate 3896 s grid of M7 (8101 epochs; diurnal aliasing checked per run), Airy far-field expected capture through the batched kernel (numpy_batch, tested against the M5 reference; capture percentiles not computed), scenario clear sky (weather upper bound).

Objectives: max `p_grid_mean_W`; min `mass_proxy_kg`; max `availability_above_threshold`

Constraints: `thermal_feasible_fraction` >= 1; `availability` >= 0.2; `peak_incident_irradiance_W_m2` <= 1000; `captured_power_peak_W` <= 1e+07; `pointing_sigma_rad` <= 5e-09; `aperture_diameter_m` <= 100
